name: unit_convert
description: Convert quantities between units with a dimensional check and an exact conversion factor: SI units with all prefixes, units accepted with the SI, and US customary and imperial units from a bundled dated table built from the SI Brochure (9th ed.) and NIST SP 811. Parses compound units (km/h, kg*m/s^2, J/(kg*K), kWh, m²) and converts temperatures in degC, degF, degR and K with their offsets.

from.description: Unit expression: names, SI prefixes, * / ^ ( ), juxtaposition, superscripts

temperature.description: Bare temperature units: with offsets (absolute) or as intervals

precision.description: Significant digits when the decimal does not terminate

list_units.description: List the table's units, prefixes and sources

catalog.source: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019, v2.01 2022) Tables 2, 4, 7 and 8; NIST SP 811 (2008) Appendix B; NIST Handbook 44 Appendix C; transcribed by tools/catalog/data/unit_convert.py (dimensional approach as in pint)
